youtube.aciklama: A flute note and a violin note played at the same pitch have the same fundamental frequency; the difference comes from the relative amplitudes of the harmonics. The perceptual quality that depends on this distribution of harmonics is called timbre. In a flute, the upper harmonics are weak and the sound is close to a pure tone; a violin has many strong harmonics.
